text: On data_seed 1, trained force R2 is about flat from N=128 (about 0.66) to N=256 (0.671-0.672), but force control R2 rises from 0.52 to 0.60-0.63. Why does the random-init force control rise at fine sampling? Is it because consecutive raw positions at N=256 sit so close together that a random projection reads r, and so 1/r^2, almost directly?
